notes: Extracted repeated validation guards into a shared private method and replaced manual if-throw patterns with .NET 8 ThrowIf helpers, reducing Building CC from 21 to 6 (GREEN). Three low-YELLOW coupling violations (12-15) remain on BuildingService, SqlBuildingRepository, and UpdateBuildingHandler; these are inherent to their responsibilities (EF Core repository pattern, multi-error-type handler, shared service with AddBuildingAsync from a different story) and cannot be reduced without breaking architecture or exceeding story scope.
